summary.intent: Fix lint failures on PR #485 (feat/api-unpin-integrity), then resolve all CodeRabbit review threads, run a simplify pass, execute the secure-phase workflow for phase 42, and resolve a second wave of CodeRabbit review threads generated by the earlier fixes.
summary.outcome: Fixed 2 prettier errors that bypassed pre-commit hooks, resolved 6 CodeRabbit threads with substantive code changes (audit suppression, scheduler fail-fast, Kubo fetch timeout, advisory lock merge, fetchQuota boolean return, backfill exit code), renamed a test file that had never been running, created 42-SECURITY.md via the secure-phase workflow, and began a second round of review resolution (transcript ends mid-execution before replies were posted).

repo: apps/web vitest config includes only **/*.test.ts — .spec.ts files are silently excluded and never run; delete.service.spec.ts (added in this PR) had never executed
GSD/Entire automated commits bypass the husky pre-commit hook (--no-verify-style), so lint-staged auto-fix never runs for executor-generated commits; CI eslint is the backstop
pnpm openapi:generate alone skips the lint:fix step, producing ~700 lines of array-formatting noise vs the committed prettier-formatted spec; pnpm api:generate is the full pipeline
gsd-commit-helper has a known false negative: reports committed:false but git log confirms the commit landed — trust git log, not the helper
NODE_ENV === 'production' is the codebase convention for production-only gating (see throttler-bypass.guard.ts); dev-only checks would incorrectly throw in test/E2E
AbortSignal.timeout() is the established codebase pattern for fetch timeouts (precedent in migration.processor.ts)
CI Typecheck job runs tsc -b on web only — apps/api spec files are excluded; the pre-existing http-metrics.interceptor.spec.ts type error is invisible to CI
check-api-client.sh pre-commit hook only blocks if openapi.json has actual uncommitted changes — internal controller edits (no endpoint/DTO change) do not trigger it
parseKuboPinLs is used exclusively by the destructive backfill script, not the tolerant drift path — fail-closed behavior is appropriate there
scripts/backfill-pinned-cids.ts is not included in any tsconfig and is not CI-typechecked

The gsd-security-auditor subagent overstepped its constraints and appended 54 lines to the repo-root SECURITY.md (the project vuln-disclosure policy from #482) instead of writing to the phase directory; required manual git revert

code.finding: guardedUnpin now accepts an optional suppressCrossUserAudit option; the internal rollback caller at line 126 passes it to suppress the false cross-user metric, while the /unpin endpoint at line 149 still audits
Scheduler registration errors now fail-fast (error + rethrow) in production, warn+continue otherwise — avoids swallowing silent failures in prod
Kubo pin/ls fetch bounded with AbortSignal.timeout(30_000) to prevent worker hang
fetchQuota now returns Promise<boolean> (success indicator) instead of Promise<void>; the no-throw contract is preserved for ~5 fire-and-forget callers to avoid unhandled rejections
deleteFile now logs a warning when fetchQuota returns false, so the warning actually fires in production (was previously in an unreachable .catch branch)
Tracks failedBatches and calls process.exit(1) on any failure; also added AbortSignal.timeout(60_000) to the Kubo fetch
parseKuboPinLs now throws on malformed NDJSON lines instead of silently skipping them (fail-closed); appropriate because this function is only used by the destructive backfill path
CodeRabbit thread [3] suggested making guardedUnpin proceed when no owned row exists — this would reintroduce the cross-tenant unpin vulnerability (T-42-06/07); correctly rejected
Renamed from .spec.ts to .test.ts so vitest picks it up; added expect(callOrder[2]).toBe('fetchQuota') to actually verify the ordering the test name claims

workflow: Write commit messages to temp files to avoid shell-escaping issues with backticks in multi-line messages
zsh arrays are 1-based — using numeric indices in gh API loops caused missed API calls; safer to use explicit variable names or xargs
When a subagent has Write access and runs with broad tool permissions, it can modify files outside its intended scope; verify git status after subagent returns before proceeding
Running openapi:generate standalone is not equivalent to pnpm api:generate — always check with api:generate or verify via git diff before concluding the spec is in sync
For CI typecheck fidelity, run pnpm typecheck (which runs tsc -b on web) + nest build (which compiles api source) rather than tsc --noEmit which may include test files CI excludes
When CodeRabbit suggests a fix, verify it doesn't reintroduce a known vulnerability — suggestions are automated and unaware of security invariants established elsewhere in the PR

friction: gsd-commit-helper false negative required verifying every commit via git log rather than trusting the helper output
gsd-security-auditor subagent clobbered the repo-root SECURITY.md (vuln-disclosure policy), requiring detection via git status and manual revert before writing the correct artifact
Shell glob expansion in zsh ate --include patterns in grep commands, requiring a retry with xargs
openapi:generate produced 714-line diff that appeared to be real spec drift but was actually formatting noise — required investigation to confirm harmless before reverting
zsh 1-based array indexing in the gh API reply loop caused two of six replies to miss, requiring explicit retry
Vitest silently excluded delete.service.spec.ts for the entire PR (wrong extension) — only discovered because the test was explicitly run and returned empty results
The transcript ends mid-execution on the second resolve-pr-reviews pass — replies were written to tmp files but not yet posted or confirmed
open_items: Four copies of the fetch-timeout pattern now exist across the codebase (tee, delegated-routing, migration.processor, pending-unpin.processor); consolidating into a shared fetchWithTimeout helper is deferred as out-of-scope for this PR
Second wave of 6 CodeRabbit review threads (from re-review of latest commits) — reply bodies were written but the transcript ends before they were posted and threads resolved
42-SECURITY.md was pushed to the PR branch (feat/api-unpin-integrity); user may prefer to keep .planning/ docs off the PR or on a dedicated branch
scripts/backfill-pinned-cids.ts is not covered by any tsconfig or CI typecheck — AbortSignal.timeout compiles in apps/api but the root script has no compile-time verification
CodeRabbit was re-reviewing after final push — new findings may arrive that need another resolution pass
